name: Borgmatic

lifecycle.note: The publisher's 2.1.8 tag and digest were read from GHCR. The portless manual recipe disables cron and prepares a passphrase, local config, and empty project-owned source/repository folders. Ordinary apply never executes it; only a separately approved version probe is bundled. Real backup scope, repository initialization, backups, scheduling, and isolated restore remain pending.

security: Protect the Borg repository passphrase, keyfiles, and any remote SSH key outside ordinary reports and logs.
Select backup sources and a repository destination only after their exact ownership is known; do not mount the Docker socket by default.
pitfalls: The publisher documents daily scheduling by default and CRON=false to disable it; do not start a backup schedule before separate source, destination, and write approval.
The recipe's managed source and repository folders are empty staging placeholders, not selected production data or an independent off-host copy.
Hooks must fail closed when a database dump or quiesce step fails; a successful archive still requires an isolated restore drill.
